title: Father practicing at home and his bowed bass
summary: His father practiced at home, was a good chord man who bowed the bass and could be heard from afar.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Uh, what was the first music you ever heard? Can you remember? It would be around home no doubt. Yes Bill. Did your father ever practice at home or?
Oh yes, yes and yeah. Bill they practiced at home most ever did. Also John and Sensei used to come home.
When your father would practice, did he practice sometime by himself on new pieces or was it usually somebody else came in and played with him?
Well he always practiced by himself on different things called. He always was a good chord man and a good bull man on bass.
Oh that's what I wanted to ask too. Did he play mostly bow or kicking in those ways?

Mostly bow. You could hear him anywhere. See sometime at night he'd have such a fairground and you could hear the beat just as good lead hours at night. You could hear the beat just as good humming. He really was a, not to brag cause he's my father. I know everybody says you don't have to be. Bill he was really good. It's different now than it was that time. And like I said Bill, I sat down and listened to a different band and we had some wonderful bands. But they're not playing the stuff that my dad and him used to play. I believe that. We just, we, my, uh, count myself too. We just trying to do what they used to do. And that's the truth. I'm not gonna lie about that. Like some fella says we do this and we do that. We don't do nothing. We trying to do.
